createPagePost.description: Compose and publish a post on a Facebook Page (or profile) through the logged-in session: open the page, open the Create post dialog, type the text, attach media files, click Post, then reload the page and confirm the text is in the feed.

pageUrl.description: Page or profile URL whose composer to use, e.g. https://www.facebook.com/dwarvesf/. The logged-in account must manage it.

text.description: Post body. Newlines are fine. Markdown backticks stay literal.

media.description: Absolute file paths to attach. Images, gif, and video are accepted by the composer's file input.

returns.description: {posted: true, url} on success (url is null when the virtualized feed hides the permalink); {posted: false, reason} on refusal (logged out, composer did not open, no Post button, text missing after reload).
